strategies.name: vwap_20sma_long_trend_bounce
strategies.entry_summary: On the 2-minute chart, get bullish once price closes above both VWAP and the 20 SMA, then enter long when a following candle confirms that move or on subsequent pullbacks/bounces that hold VWAP as support without closing and building below it. strategies.exit_summary: For a quick scalp, take profits into the upper VWAP band. For a larger hold, stay in the trade while VWAP and the 20 SMA trend higher, then use the 20 SMA as a trailing stop and exit on a close below it once price has separated upward from VWAP.
